headline: Renewables Reach 63% of Total Installed Power Capacity in Türkiye
summary: The Energy and Natural Resources Ministry announced that Türkiye's total installed electricity generation capacity reached 127,355 megawatts by the end of September.
why: Turkey's energy sector investments highlight the transition toward renewable generation capacity in emerging market infrastructure.

impacts.name: Turkish Energy Utilities
impacts.why: Expansion in renewable generation capacity alters the long-term asset base for domestic power utilities.
